R329.note: Content-sniffed MIME allowlist plus a server-generated uuid filename closes the dangerous-type upload; the filename/extension rewrite is the only other observable change and is stated plainly, and legitimate PNG/JPEG uploads still succeed.

R330.note: EvalSymlinks plus a post-resolution containment check closes the symlink escape, but every EvalSymlinks failure is collapsed to os.ErrPermission, so a legitimately missing file now returns a permission error instead of the *PathError/ErrNotExist the original os.ReadFile produced, and the write-up only alludes to that.

R331.note: @EnableMethodSecurity is the right mechanism, but the delivered SecurityConfig.java declares package com.example.config while every other class is com.example.accounts, so a scan rooted at the app package would not register it, leaving @PreAuthorize inert; it also overwrites the case's SecurityConfig, silently deleting the SecurityFilterChain bean with anyRequest().authenticated() without mentioning it.

R332.note: Dropping LIBXML_NOENT stops entity substitution (external entity loading is already off by default on libxml 2.9+ under PHP 8.2) and the added LIBXML_NONET blocks no legitimate parse of the well-formed submission; title/body extraction is unchanged.

R333.note: Parameterized @Actor with SqlDbType.NVarChar closes the injection, the added using System.Data is accounted for, and apostrophe-bearing actor values are still counted literally with the same JSON count response.

R334.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) removes the null unboxing and matches the stated contract exactly - present SKUs subtract the stored count, absent SKUs behave as zero reservation.

R335.note: toRealPath + resolve + normalize + startsWith containment rejects both ../ traversal and absolute cookie values, the SecurityException lands in the pre-existing catch-all so the failure path is unchanged, and legitimate filenames still resolve to the same file.

R336.note: Argument-array exec.CommandContext removes the shell and the leading-dash rejection covers flag injection, but the added 30s timeout is a new restriction: a slow-but-legitimate traceroute over 15 hops that previously returned output now yields HTTP 500, and the write-up presents it only as defence in depth.

R337.note: Dropping the envp array removes the only path by which the untrusted header reached the child process; the resulting switch to inheriting the parent environment is stated plainly and the command, its output and the error handling are otherwise untouched.

R338.note: DOMPurify.sanitize before bypassSecurityTrustHtml strips script and event-handler markup while default config keeps b/em/a formatting; the named CVE and 3.4.0 floor could not be verified from the bundle, and in a non-browser Node context DOMPurify needs a window, but in the Angular browser build this is the standard shape.

R339.note: headerLen > UINT32_MAX - payloadLen is a correct non-wrapping pre-check, so totalSize now always equals the bytes both memcpys write; the only added behaviour is a std::overflow_error on the malicious sums, which is stated and leaves all in-range callers unaffected.

R340.note: Keeps the original string check, adds EvalSymlinks and re-applies containment to the resolved path, and propagates the resolution error unchanged so a missing file still surfaces as the same not-exist PathError.

R341.note: Per-event socket.user.role check inside admin:broadcastMessage closes the missing authorization; nothing else in the file changes and the silent return matches the sibling handlers' existing style.

R342.note: The regex denylist does not close the vector - run in a scratch dir on Node 24, the script emit.constructor('return this')() with 'process' and 'require' built by string concatenation passed every pattern and wrote a marker file to disk, and Object.freeze(sandbox) changed nothing (top-level var still worked); the denylist also rejects otherwise valid merchant scripts that merely contain text like 'process.' or 'import '.

R343.note: Adds requireRole('admin') to the export route, matching the middleware chain every sibling admin route already uses; no other line changes.

R344.note: json_encode with JSON_HEX_TAG|HEX_AMP|HEX_APOS|HEX_QUOT emits its own quoted literal that cannot break the JS string or close the script tag, the removal of the surrounding quotes is stated, and the banner still renders the note.
